fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-02-22 around 10:35 hrs, it was reported that the complainant reported threatening messages from a loan recovery number regarding Rs. 50,000. A person named Eswari Raj, associated with the number 9000000433, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and mobile phone records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00321, as the mobile number 9000000433 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Recovery agents allegedly sent abusive messages to the borrower and contacts.
